title: CORE-7121 · SHARED: testimonial quote fixed per page — live rotates per load
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7121](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7121) · **PR** #113

Premise verified before any code. **Correct.**

Live `/company-name-change/`: 6 cold-cache loads → **5 distinct quotes**; `/renewals/` → 4 distinct of 6.
Two facts pinned it down:

- **Client-side, not server-side.** 8 curls of the same URL returned *byte-identical* HTML (450,550 bytes,
  always David Reid) while the rendered DOM showed four other people. The swap happens at hydration.
- **Per-load random, not a carousel.** The value at +6s equalled the value at hydration in every load;
  no controls, no auto-advance.

Mechanism, decompiled from the shipped Gatsby chunk (module 63231):
`e[Math.floor(Math.random() * e.length)].node` — inline in the render body. Live ships all 9 testimonials
to every client via static query `3724112457` — the same 9 the clone holds in `testimonialPool`.

Clone used `pool[pick(id, pool.length)]` — a hash of the Payload block id, so fixed per page forever.

## The change

Server component passes the whole pool plus the existing deterministic index to a new client component
`TestimonialQuoteRotator.tsx`, which swaps to a per-load random index via `useSyncExternalStore`.
`getServerSnapshot` returns the deterministic index so SSR stays cacheable and hydration matches exactly;
`Math.random()` runs once at module scope, never during render.

Three rejected approaches: server-side `Math.random()` (baked into the cached RSC payload);
`Math.random()` in a client render body (React 19 hydration mismatch — live gets away with it on React 17);
`useState` + `setState` in `useEffect` (worked, but the repo's ESLint rejects `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`).

## Evidence

Screenshots in the PR: live rotating across 4 loads; clone before showing the same quote 3× (the three
element PNGs are byte-identical, 61,259 bytes each); clone after rotating across 4, on a production build.

**Known divergence, documented not hidden:** the seed is per hard page load, so a client-side soft-nav
between two block-carrying pages keeps the same quote where live would re-pick.

**Separate bug found:** clone slugs `business-address`, `service-address`, `london-registered-office`
404 on live at that path — live nests them under `/additional-services/<slug>/`. Not touched.
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonial quote differs across cold-cache page loads, as live does.
Server HTML stays deterministic so the route remains cacheable.
Zero hydration console errors on a production build.
No markup, layout or style change to the block.
